gen-flavors-fs-epilogue: Chunky, playful capitals with a towering lowercase. Epilogue follows in a plain sans, curvy and wiry, giving Flavors' stubby loudness something light to lean on.
gen-tourney-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab reads like a text serif with a gaping c and tall, rounded lowercase. Tourney's wide-tracked, single-width strokes make the loud half, and the pair's best quality is how loudly those two disagree.
gen-tourney-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads low and literary, its middle band tall and its ascenders shallow. Tourney then stretches its bulky, wide-tracked words above it, a pencil-line heading over a text serif that stays quietly dignified.
gen-tourney-gf-glegoo: Bulky, stretched capitals meet roomy curves below. Glegoo, the text serif, has big counters you can enlarge a notch without losing its refined editorial tone, while Tourney keeps its tubing-bent heading as is.
gen-tourney-gf-hanuman: Tourney stretches out in wide-tracked, marker-traced strokes, bold and athletic. Hanuman sits beneath as a text serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, traditional against all that bulk.
gen-tourney-gf-kadwa: Heavy, uniform strokes stretched wide, with bulky small letters and no thick-thin shifts anywhere in sight. Kadwa, a classic serif, backs it with open-ended curves and a generous x-height.
gen-tourney-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads dignified and literary, with a big entrance into each curve. Noticia Text then sits under Tourney's lockstep curves and stems like a classic serif, its lowercase filling most of the letter height.
gen-tourney-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads refined, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Tourney does the shouting with marker-tip strokes and wide tracking, while Piazzolla's pried-open e does the quiet, authoritative talking.
gen-tourney-gf-pridi: Tourney draws everything with a technical pen's single line weight. Pridi, a serif with proud, near-capital small letters and generous gaps where curves meet stems, would read classic and refined over many paragraphs.
gen-tourney-gf-scope-one: Wide, heavy, athletic lettering with no pinched joins. And Scope One, a text serif with spilling counters and stubby ascenders beside its big x-height, gives that bulk a traditional, refined counterpart.
